Package org.example

Class GradeBook

java.lang.Object
org.example.GradeBook
public class GradeBook extends Object
Represents a student's electronic grade book. Provides calculations for average grade, budget transfer, honors diploma, and scholarship.

      public double getAverageGrade()
      Calculates the current average grade for the entire study period. Non-differentiated credits are ignored.
      Returns:
      the average grade, or 0.0 if there are no numeric grades

    • canTransferToBudget

      public boolean canTransferToBudget()
      Checks if the student can transfer from paid to budget education. Only the last two examination sessions are considered.
      Returns:
      true if the transfer is possible, false otherwise

    • canGetHonorsDiploma

      public boolean canGetHonorsDiploma()
      Predicts the possibility of receiving an honors diploma. The function can be used before the completion of studies.
      Returns:
      true if the student is on track for an honors diploma, else false

    • canGetIncreasedScholarship

      public boolean canGetIncreasedScholarship()
      Checks if the student is eligible for an increased scholarship next semester. Only the results of the current semester are evaluated.
      Returns:
      true if the student is worth an increased scholarship, else false
